nom: NUXE Nuxuriance Ultra Global Anti-Aging Face Cream, Hyaluronic Acid, 1.7 Oz

avis.titre: So rich and luxurious!So rich and luxurious!
avis.texte: I love this day cream. I discovered NUXE products when I was visiting Amsterdam and it changed my relationship with skin care. Smoothes my skin and visibly reduces wrinkles. I also use the NUXE face and eye serum. It is expensive but totally worth it!
Love all my Nuxe products! Lacking silicone and sulfate ingredients makes a world of difference!
